name: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_gcd < T > (left : usize , mid : * mut T , right : usize)
rule: The range of `left + right` elements of type `T` starting at `mid - left` and ending just before `mid + right` must be valid for reading and writing.
api: unsafe fn ptr_rotate_gcd < T > (left : usize , mid : * mut T , right : usize)
expression: (($1 + $3) * $2.$mem.pointee.size == 0) or ($2.$mem.pointee.allocation.exists and $2.$mem.pointee.allocation.live and $2.$mem.pointee.allocation.start <= $2.$mem.pointee.start - $1 * $2.$mem.pointee.size and $2.$mem.pointee.start + $3 * $2.$mem.pointee.size <= $2.$mem.pointee.allocation.end and $3 * $2.$mem.pointee.size <= $2.$mem.pointee.readable_size and $3 * $2.$mem.pointee.size <= $2.$mem.pointee.writable_size)
